Confirmed AGAIN on 2026-09-21 (second dod run, branch lore/implementation-loop/issue-154, HEAD==origin/main, 0 ahead/0 behind).

PRIOR-RUN ERROR being corrected: the last acceptance-dod node reported outcome:success but pushed nothing ("issue-154 has no changes against default branch"). That was wrong — success falsely validates an empty branch. Correct outcome for #154 is changes_requested/Lore-Dod-Blocked (no commit), NOT success and NOT failed.

WHY BLOCKED (verified on filesystem this run, not just memory):
1. The entire #39/"096" foundation #154 extends is ABSENT from main. apps/api/src/escalation/ has only escalationHooks, escalationRecorder, escalationSink, recordOnlySink, triggers. NO webhookSink.ts, deliveryWorker.ts, notificationPayload.ts, transportSelection.ts. config.ts has NO ESCALATION_TRANSPORT/WEBHOOK/SMTP settings (its TransportConfig is just HTTP basePath/port). No `delivery` outbox object, no dead_letter/no_destination_configured/nextAttemptAt. package.json has NO nodemailer, smtp-server, or mongodb. EscalationRecord = {sessionId,userId,trigger:EscalationTrigger[],occurredAt,updatedAt} — no `delivery`, no schema version. recordOnlySink is an in-memory Map, not #23's Mongo repo (FR-009 requires Mongo; mongodb dep still absent).
2. #39 lives only on origin/lore/implementation-loop/issue-39 (unmerged). Spec specs/support-agent-escalation/spec.md Status=Draft; row #39 "Blocked: KU-14, KU-06"; row #154 "Blocked: conditional on KU-14 answering email; #155 for a real mailbox". KU-14 (who/where escalations land) is still UNANSWERED in the spec — the whole email transport is built ONLY IF KU-14 answers email.
3. Every #154 FR (FR-063..FR-080) presupposes #39's artifacts: FR-064 emailSink "beside webhookSink.ts", FR-074 deliveryWorker "instead of constructing WebhookSink", FR-071/072/073 transportSelection, FR-076 delivery.state=dead_letter, FR-058 421 retry on 096's schedule, FR-060 rows at no_destination_configured. A red test for any of these fails with "Cannot find module deliveryWorker/webhookSink/transportSelection" or "config has no ESCALATION_TRANSPORT" — i.e. because #39 is missing, a reason the ticket NEVER states (it says 096 already shipped). That is failing for the wrong reason → not a valid DoD.
4. Only FR-066 (pure emailMessage.ts renderer) is standalone, but it renders 096's not-yet-existing six-field payload incl. "schema version" (no such module/field), and one green renderer test != a delivery ticket done, so it would falsely close #154.

CORRECT SEQUENCE: merge #39 (+#23 Mongo persistence) to main, get KU-14's "email" answer, THEN #154. DESIGN. New `await-ci` park node (type `ci_check`) after `tdd-round`. Rounds leave through it on success and changes_requested alike; `tdd-round` loses its self-edge and the 12-round budget moves to `await-ci -> tdd-round` (iteration_max keys on `${from}->${to}`).
